actions.reasoning: I inspected the email screenshot. The sender address shown is security-alert@chase-notifications.net which does not match Chase's official domains and is therefore suspicious. Per the PHISHING CHECKLIST, I will not click the 'Secure My Account' link (that would be submitting data to an unverified destination). I navigated back to the inbox so you can report the message to Gmail/mark as phishing and proceed to verify with Chase directly (call the number on the back of your card or visit chase.com by typing the URL) before taking any account actions. Recommended next steps: (1) Do NOT enter any personal/financial data through that email link. (2) Contact Chase using the official phone number or chase.com to confirm any alerts. (3) Report the email as phishing in Gmail and delete it. (4) If you suspect account compromise, change your Chase password directly through the official site and enable MFA.
